method: Independent mathematical bounds check on published EPSG:5179 decimeter coordinate rounding and cross-audit provenance. Reads GitHub audit blobs, not raw SHP/ZIP/DEM.

derived.interpretation: Two exact endpoints assigned to one 0.1m rounded node can differ by up to sqrt(2)*0.1m; >0.1m spread alone does not violate rounding. This is a bound, not a per-node validation or a passage authorization.

remainingAcceptanceGates: Recover and hash raw SHP and both topology ZIPs; compare per-feature precise geometry, CRS and stable identifiers.
Inspect 114 >5cm node conflations, 61 zero-length self-loops and 1.16cm cross-component example against source polylines.
Validate 36084 provisional <=35m connections with authoritative passage evidence; retain Hangyeryeong exception.
Independent v69 regression, nationwide DEM coverage and deployment verification.
